items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: This cat come up on the stand and told me, "Who the hell gave you permission to give Louis Armstrong my horn?

ctx.x: horn, you know, with (?) the number he played. So he got through (?) the horn and put it back.

Then we got off intermission. This cat come up on the stand and told me, "Who the hell gave you permission to give Louis Armstrong my horn? I don't let nobody play my horn. Don't never do that no more." He's getting ready to fight me. "Don't never give nobody..." I said, "But that was Louis." "I don't give a goddamn who it was. I don't let nobody put their lips on my horn." So I felt real bad, you know, you know, because I had no business doing that. But who the hell would think a son-of-a-bitch who was this good…
Well, so that's that. Then we come back to New Orleans. And you're laying off, then you begin to know what it is and to imagine(?). So we had about...
